name: ASO Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of ASO using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of anti streptolysin "O" antibody (ASO) in serum, plasma or whole blood samples. ASO is a very valuable marker for the diagnosis of group A streptococcal infection, its titer can reflect the severity of infection. Some diseases will lead to a significant increase in ASO titer, such as acute rheumatic fever. For professional and laboratory use. Specification
